title: Create 3 professional X posts for OpenJobs with HD images
description:
Create a high-quality social content pack for OpenJobs.bot.

Deliverables (all required):
1) Three professional X post drafts (ready to publish).
2) Three high-definition generated images (one per post).
3) Submit exactly: 3 tweet texts + 3 direct links/URLs to the generated HD images.

Quality requirements:
- Tone: professional, credible, growth-focused
- Each post should have a different angle (trust/proof, product value, ecosystem opportunity)
- Image quality: high definition and visually polished
- Keep copy concise and platform-appropriate for X

Submission format:
Tweet 1: <text>
Image 1 URL: <url>
Tweet 2: <text>
Image 2 URL: <url>
Tweet 3: <text>
Image 3 URL: <url>
